title: Gird Your Loins: Lady Gaga Has Three Songs on ‘Devil Wears Prada 2’ Soundtrack
summary: Dua Lipa, Laufey, SZA, Olivia Dean and more are also featured on the album.
contentText:
Miranda Priestley is a Little Monster, confirmed.

Interscope and 20th Century Pictures unveiled the official tracklist for the Devil Wears 2 via Instagram on Wednesday (April 29) and it features not one, not two, but three Lady Gaga songs.

Ahead of the big reveal, Lady Gaga and Doechii released their collaboration “Runway,” the first single from the upcoming soundtrack, on April 9. The superstar duo kept the excitement going by dropping the fashion-forward music video for “Runway” on Monday (April 27). Soon, two new solo Gaga tracks, “Shape of a Woman” and “Glamorous Life,” will join “Runway” as the first three songs on the Devil Wears Prada 2 soundtrack.

Alongside the three Gaga tunes, there will be 10 other songs on the Devil Wears Prada 2 soundtrack by an all-women cast of artists. Billboard’s February 2026 chart breaker Sienna Spiro and singer-songwriter Izzy Escobar both penned new songs on the soundtrack with “Material Lover” and “Evergreen Avenue,” respectively.

Familiar tracks like SZA’s “Saturn,” Dua Lipa ‘s “End of an Era,” Raye ‘s “Worth It” and Olivia Dean ‘s “Nice to Each Other” are also included on the soundtrack. “Runway” is not the only collaboration on the LP: an edit of Miley Cyrus and Brittany Howard ‘s 2025 team-up “Walk of Fame” also makes an appearance on the album. Rounding out the all-star lineup, Laufey , Ledisi and The Marías are also all featured on the soundtrack.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 soundtrack will be released alongside the film on Friday (May 1). Fans can pre-save the album here . See the full tracklist below.
